item.title: Solved: How to Get the Output of Each Layer in Keras
item.description: When working with Keras to construct deep learning models, particularly for binary classification tasks powered by convolutional neural networks (CNNs), you may find yourself needing to capture the output of each layer during the forward pass of your model. This capability is essential for visualizing how data flows through the model, troubleshooting, or simply understanding feature extraction at every layer. Below are various methods to achieve this, illustrated with unique code examples.
